Steven Spielberg who brought us alien classics like E.T. and Close Encounters of the Third Kind (and also Indiana Jones and the Crystal Skull) is back in alien territory with Disclosure Day!

The movie definitely raises some questions though. Like why don’t we get to see what happens after the disclosure? Wouldn’t that be the most interesting part? What’s up with the magic text that can do anything? Also wait, that guy had a living alien this whole time?
